pro_course_detail.title: Mastering the mother of all languages - Tamil
pro_course_detail.description: Hello all, to begin with we are going to take baby steps in Tamil. As how a new born child takes slowly its time to build up letter pronunciation and later to a complete word then into a group of words to form sentence, here we are going to do the same albeit we are rather grown up kids.  Firstly we will focus on the alphabets that are present, until you get your right pronunciation, I am not going to leave you :D (on a lighter note) Here I am obliged to give you the right lessons, so you are the master here and you should extract as much work from me as possible.  Its going to be a win-win situation for both the teacher and the student, where the teacher pushes the student to go extra mile in their efforts which in turn motivates the teacher to further up his efforts. Use me, trouble me until you get your basic rights, I believe in learning a new language, it is the learner who should ask more questions and doubts, only then you can master the art. As the saying "Rome was not built in a day", a language which is alien to you cannot be learnt overnight. Its a gradual process. You need to be very honest and stay true to your efforts.  If they are done in a right manner, you will see the results coming up. You can assess your performance from where you were before the start and where you are now.  That is how learning is done.  This is what change is.  Enjoy the process, feel it, love it, involve and immerse yourself in this beautiful journey.  By putting yourself in a situation in learning a new language itself shows how stand out you are from others.  And before ending up, I have to quote this favourite dialogue of mine from the movie "Batman Begins". "Why do we fall? So that we learn to pick ourselves up!" Make mistakes, fail, try again, fail better and learn what not do. Never lose your heart, when the going gets tough, the tough gets going. Looking forward to meet you in this journey. pro_course_detail.description:
The biggest challenge for language learners is to be able to speak fluently and have meaningful conversations with their friends or colleagues. Most learners are unable to acquire fluency in their speech simply because they don't have the right environment to practice. 

This course aims at providing precisely such an environment where you can speak on various topics and get instant feedback on how you can improve.

In this lesson:
1. Our primary focus will be on Listening and Speaking.
2. I will give you various topics (of which I have an endless list) on which you will speak and express your opinions. 

What you can expect from these sessions:
1. These sessions will be highly interactive. Our conversations will be fun and dynamic and will range over various topics
2. I believe in an input based approach. Therefore, I will give you content to watch in nearly all sessions. I would like you to free up some time from your schedule for these listening exercises. 
3. Speaking activities will include: expressing your opinion on a given topic, storytelling and relating past anecdotes, answering questions about a topic, giving recommendations, extempore speeches, casual conversations and much more. 

What makes these sessions useful for you?
1. During the session itself, I will correct your errors and give you a feedback on your areas of improvement.
2. Alongside speaking and listening, we will be focusing on fluency (fillers), grammar, vocabulary, and pronunciation. 
3. You can bring any questions or doubts you might have regarding grammar or any other language-related topic and we will discuss them together at length.

2. We will learn the pronunciation of commonly mispronounced words.

Series, films, stand-ups, and talk shows are some of the most fun, interesting content out there to learn a language. If you feel the same way, then this class is perfect for you.

In this class:
1. We will watch a clip from a sitcom or a talk-show and answer questions based on the video. Additionally, we will have a conversation related to the clip. 
2. Alongside the questions, we will analyse the clip to learn new vocabulary, grammar rules, stress and intonation patters, and much more. 
3. The clips are from various sitcoms and other content including (but not in any way limited to) Modern Family, Big Bang, Brooklyn 99, and of course, Friends.

Offer: If, regrettably, sitcoms or talk-shows do not interest you and you would like to do these activities on a film or series you love, no need to worry. If before the sessions, you can convey to me what content you would like, we can do exercises from that as well.

pro_course_detail.title: English to improve Reading skills (all levels)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we will focus on helping improve your reading skills in English. I have a lot of reading material for all different levels. In my lesson, I always start with a pre-reading task, that can be a short video or a discussion of the topic we are going to read about. This is to help you get some background knowledge about the topic. Once we are done with the re-reading task, we will move on to the actual reading material, which we can take turns reading, or I can ask you to read it if you are comfortable with that. We can focus on both skimming the text, that is having a general understanding of the text, and scanning, that is looking for specific information given in the text. If you have your own material, I am happy to use that in our lesson as well. After the reading task, we will move on to the post-reading task in which you can present your ideas on what you learnt from the text, or write a short report. You are also free to book my trial lesson first, so that we can get to know each other a bit, and I can learn more about your English learning experiences, and your requirements and objectives.

I look forward to talking to you soon :)
